'''2003 Maryland State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Maryland (26 April 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Maryland
* '''Dates:''' 26 April 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Venue:''' Games, Comics, and Stuff, Glen Burnie, Maryland<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' Jeffrey Cook<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Kevin Elia]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
